definitions.explanation: Describes a warm, fond feeling toward something from the past. The subject evokes pleasant memories.

examples.japanese: この{歌|うた}を{聞|き}くと{懐|なつ}かしい。
examples.english: Hearing this song makes me feel nostalgic.

examples.japanese: {懐|なつ}かしい{友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I met an old friend I hadn't seen in a long time.

examples.japanese: お{久|ひさ}しぶり！{懐|なつ}かしいね。
examples.english: Long time no see! It brings back memories.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}に{遊|あそ}んだ{公園|こうえん}を{見|み}て、{懐|なつ}かしくなった。
examples.english: Seeing the park where I played as a child made me feel nostalgic.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}ていたら、{学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}の{懐|なつ}かしい{思|おも}い{出|で}がたくさんよみがえってきた。
examples.english: While looking at old photos, many fond memories from my student days came flooding back.

notes:
Unique Japanese emotion describing fond feelings about the past. There's no exact English equivalent—it combines 'nostalgic,' 'I miss it,' and 'brings back memories.'

IMPORTANT USAGE:
Unlike English, the thing you're nostalgic for is the subject, not the object:
・{故郷|ふるさと}が{懐|なつ}かしい (I miss my hometown - lit. 'hometown is natsukashii')
・NOT: {私|わたし}は{故郷|ふるさと}を{懐|なつ}かしむ

FORMS:
・{懐|なつ}かしく{思|おも}う (to feel nostalgic about)
・{懐|なつ}かしさ (nostalgia - noun)
・{懐|なつ}かしがる (to act nostalgic about)
